name: Esja
source:
Yeseniya Lyubovich is the heart and soul of her social circle—a bright and compassionate young woman whose boundless optimism stands in stark contrast to the grim reality of the world around her. The younger twin sister of the protagonist, Yesya is a source of warmth and emotional support, always ready to lift the spirits of those around her. She is deeply involved in humanitarian efforts, volunteering for aid organizations, fundraising for those in need, and believing that change begins with kindness rather than violence.

Yesya’s energy is infectious—she laughs easily, teases those she cares about, and refuses to let cynicism define her. She has a strong moral compass and an innate ability to sense when others are struggling, often pushing them to open up even when they don’t want to. Despite her idealism, she isn’t naive—she knows the world is cruel, but she believes in fighting cruelty with compassion rather than hatred.
